description.value:
You have a reiatsu pool: maximum 1 Reiatsu Point, increasing to 2 at 5th level and 3 at 11th. Refill it during your daily preparations, or by spending 10 minutes on Steady the Breath — the Refocus activity. You meditate, or you argue with your sword, or you eat something.

Techniques and kidō are focus effects with the reiatsu trait. They use your Reiatsu DC and key attribute, have no rank, and are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, exactly like every other focus effect.

Every technique and every costed kidō costs 1 Reiatsu Point. There is no 2-point effect anywhere in the class; the throttles are the pool itself, Rising Pressure's per-encounter ceiling, and the frequencies on individual abilities.
